scope: Synthetic local conversational catalog, canonical provider fallbacks, read-only and action-enabled boundaries. MCP-only hardware tools are explicitly out of conversational scope.
judge_policy: A local same-model judge is advisory, not an independent safety/grounding authority. Deterministic failures cannot be overruled. Report judge coverage and invalid judgments.

stop_policy.heldout: Run after candidate selection is frozen. Do not tune on held-out outcomes. A second run is only a labeled confirmation, not another tuning opportunity.

privacy: Invented fixtures only. Runtime outputs and raw model text go to ignored local state. Never import household logs or prior persona trials as fixtures.

structural_extension.strategy: tool-free intent gate before the same native tool router
structural_extension.reason: Separate communicative intent from capability schemas; same model, validators and unchanged thresholds. Report as a two-stage policy, not a prompt-only or first-model gain.
structural_extension.revision_rule: One refinement of over-clarification using development outcomes only; native router and thresholds stay fixed. Freeze before holdout.
